# Vendored test dependency

`feloy-video-captions-0.1.0.tgz` is the unmodified `@feloy/video-captions` 0.1.0 package. It includes its Apache-2.0 license and source files. The original project is [feloy/video-captions](https://github.com/feloy/video-captions).

The package is stored here so CI and container builds can install dependencies without GitHub Packages credentials. Its SHA-512 integrity is `sha512-wfxwTZQ/6PrphuonI0gxQRIH74rSbbgVmnq/Dsme7gtn4lXMj4Rp1M96tSmSkssr9SlEax9gtCTw3SMjElJtFQ==`, matching the package previously recorded in `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
